name: Scan a Code
description: Read QR codes and barcodes on-device, with nothing sent to any cloud. A reader, not an opener: it decodes, classifies and explains what a code carries - links, Wi-Fi, contacts, product codes - and lets you act deliberately. Copy is always the first action; opening, joining or adding is an explicit, informed tap.

featured.blurb: Read any code, safely and offline

inputs.label: Source
inputs.help: Point the camera at a code, scan a saved image, or paste a code's text to inspect it. Whatever the source, the code is read on this device - nothing is uploaded.

inputs.label: Image
inputs.help: A photo or screenshot containing a code. The bytes stay in memory on this device.

inputs.label: Code text
inputs.help: Paste the exact text a scanner returned, to inspect it with the same safety checks without pointing a camera.

inputs.label: Keep scans on this device
inputs.help: Off by default. When on, a session list of scans is kept in this browser only (never uploaded) and can be cleared with one action. Masked secrets are never kept.
